about: Real dbt artifacts for lineagepilot_core tests. synth-24 comes from spike S2 (spikes/s2-parse-perf/tests/fixtures, copied on 2026-11-02, where scripts/make_fixtures.py regenerates it). pilot-1.12 and pilot-fusion-2.0 are built from fixtures/pilot-shop by its make_fixture.py; on 13 November 2026 they replaced copies of dbt-labs/jaffle-shop, which has no licence (beads LP-0tf). legacy-v11 is data-capsule's hand-written backend fixture, kept only as an older-schema input. Do not edit these files: tests mutate copies in memory.

pilot-1.12.licence: Written for this repository; not derived from jaffle-shop.
pilot-1.12.steps: seed, run, test, docs generate; macros emptied

pilot-fusion-2.0.licence: Written for this repository; not derived from jaffle-shop.

legacy-v11.dbt: hand-written, claims dbt 1.7.0 and manifest schema v11
legacy-v11.note: Not a real dbt artifact: it puts data_tests lists on columns, which real manifests never have (spike S2 suspicion 2).
